item.title: New Roads police chief resigns amid controversy, residents want answers

item.title: WBRZ Investigative Unit: Justice of the peace working outside jurisdiction signs agreement to stop

item.title: Despite tough season, LSU football sends large number of players to NFL Combine

item.title: Family, sheriff's office searching for runaway 17-year-old

item.title: Mardi Gras parade held for patients at Our Lady of the Lake Children's Hospital
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Members of the Krewe of Comogo and Krewe of Artemis, along with area first responders, took part in the annual parade for patients at Our Lady of the Lake Children's Hospital.The kids also received gift bags filled with beads and other throws assembled by the groups.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Port Allen community comes through to help veteran clean up his property
